## The Stretch-Shortening Cycle

A common mistake is to confuse plyometrics (the exercise the athlete performs) with the stretch-shortening cycle (the mechanism underlying the tissue response). The stretchshortening cycle involves the tissue response to the three phases of a plyometric exercise as described above. -1 shows the three phases of the stretch-shortening cycle along with the underlying physiology that accompanies each phase.
